query:
with cte as (
    insert into user_color
    (user_id, color, index)
    values ($1, $2, (select count(*) from user_color where user_id = $1)) returning color
), colors as (
    select color
    from user_color
    where user_id = $1
    order by index
)
select color as "color!" from colors
union all
select color as "color!" from cte
